title: What are the features of Eight70 Warranty?
text:
What are the features of Eight70 Warranty?

Eight70 Warranty covers the battery for a total of 8 years/80 000 km. This is the first and only warranty in the industry to cover not just battery failures, but degradation too. The battery is guaranteed to stay above 70% health till the end of the 8th year, else, it will be replaced. Any and all battery defects (cell, electrical, electronic, BMS etc.) are covered under these plans. Idle state assurance: no claim rejection due to deep discharge of battery cells when the scooter is left uncharged or in an idle state
